title: HURT PILLAGERS CHARGE OR FLEE AND EVADE GRENADES
why: His g-23 answer: Some back off, some charge. His g-28 answer: They run from it. Watch: a nearly dead pillager that charges is more dangerous; watch deaths to low-health pillagers and whether the charge reads as a choice. Watch frag kill rate because fleeing may make grenades harder to kill with; cooking is the counter.
now: About forty percent of hurt hostile pillagers charge for four seconds rather than smoke and flee. All standing pillagers run from live grenades after a short reaction, including hires, simulated raids and party copies. Golden pillagers keep their exemption.
